criteria.title: Preserve question-specific authority
criteria.model: Shipped agent guidance assigns each question class to exactly one authority (graph: topology; LSP: compiler semantics; rg: current text; ast-grep: syntax) and never routes a semantic or current-text question to the graph.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) shipped guidance names the graph as authority for a compiler-semantic or current-text question; (2) guidance.integration.test.ts 'publishes local guidance through actual tools/list and refuses raw query without another child' is red or absent; (3) its mutation case 'the same discovery oracle rejects an isolated forbidden-next-route mutation' is red or absent; (4) Serena appears in any guidance route; (5) existing guidance overrides or code:run access are forked instead of reused. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read the testing:runs rows (source=ci, worktreeDirty=false, committed candidate) for guidance.integration.test.ts and runtime-artifact-parity.test.ts, then capability:read packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/graph-fallback-guidance.ts and libs/papercusp/plugins/gitnexus-bridge/index.ts guidance text. Cite the it() titles in marker (2) and (3) by name. index.test.ts is deliberately NOT bound: its 64 tests pin plugin surface (PATH fallbacks), not authority. GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement); this bar constrains how agents consume it, not which engine. PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Actionable, truthful guidance
criteria.model: Shipped guidance fires on known-symbol and shared-helper-change questions, shows the fallback matching the failure class, and never promises complete consumers or exact current source.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) guidance sends agents to a refused raw query path (guidance.integration.test.ts 'publishes local guidance through actual tools/list and refuses raw query without another child' red or absent); (2) guidance promises every consumer or exact current source; (3) the fallback shown does not match the failure class; (4) runtime-artifact-parity.test.ts 'is up to date with index.ts (regenerate with: npm run gen:gitnexus-bridge)' is red, i.e. source and generated artifact drifted; (5) 'ships the agent-facing tool guidance that the hand-written mirror omitted' is red; (6) the known-symbol or shared-helper-change trigger text is absent from the shipped guidance. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read the testing:runs rows for guidance.integration.test.ts and runtime-artifact-parity.test.ts at the committed candidate, then compare the shipped guidance text (capability:read libs/papercusp/plugins/gitnexus-bridge/index.ts) with the generated runtime artifact. index.test.ts is deliberately NOT bound (plugin-surface tests). GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement). PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Truthful failure and coverage
criteria.model: The code-intelligence contract reports source coverage only against a measured denominator and never collapses distinct result states (graph edge, file-level link, limited output, stale revision, missing/unindexed symbol, backend failure) into one another.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) contracts.ts collapses two of the six states (graph edge, file-level link, limited output, stale revision, missing/unindexed symbol, backend failure) into one; (2) an empty, non-truncated, fresh result claims source coverage without a measured denominator; (3) graph-coverage.integration.test.ts 'propagates a fresh-index miss without turning it into source absence' or 'reports ambiguity and backend failure distinctly across the handler' is red or absent; (4) contracts.test.ts 'grades an unmeasured backend not-measured, NOT within-budget' or 'grades a TRUNCATED walk not-measured even when the partial total looks fine' is red or absent. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read testing:runs rows for graph-coverage.integration.test.ts, lsp-facade-coverage.test.ts and contracts.test.ts at the committed candidate, and capability:read packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/contracts.ts to confirm the six states are distinct types or fields. GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement). PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Reliable existing backend
criteria.model: The known-symbol omission in the installed GitNexus 1.6.9 backend is reproduced, root-caused, guarded and fixed, and no refresh/restart/crash class is closed by restart alone.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) gitnexus-exact-index.integration.test.ts 'omits a known declaration at the vendor default, then indexes it at the routine-derived limit' is red or absent (omission not reproduced); (2) gitnexus-reindex-mutation-control.test.ts 'rejects a healthy-looking graph when its known source file is absent' is red, or the control survives removal of the guard; (3) gitnexus-recovery.integration.test.ts 'recovers a known call edge after a reader is killed without changing snapshot provenance' is red or absent (crash class); (4) gitnexus-reindex-action.test.ts 'refreshes when the indexed commit is no longer in history (rebase/prune)' or 'says the rebuild is FORCED and the marker deliberately kept' is red or absent (refresh class); (5) any class is closed by a restart only, with no guard; (6) an upgrade is adopted without a passing measured failure fixture, contradicting D-002. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read testing:runs rows for the four gitnexus routine tests at the committed candidate and cite the it() titles in markers (1)-(4) by name; a work-item or completion comment is never code truth for this bar. GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement): the full-rebuild policy stays until a candidate passes its failure fixture. PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Selective agent adoption
criteria.model: Bounded graph evidence is attached only at known-symbol navigation and shared-code impact decisions through the existing routing/eval surfaces, with no per-grep, per-read or per-turn graph call.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) selective-assist.test.ts 'fires on a known identifier for every identifier-shaped frozen corpus query' or 'fires on a substantive change to an exported shared helper, and only then' is red or absent; (2) a legitimate non-use (text, log, runtime query) dispatches a graph call: the 'none (reason) with zero dispatches' cases are red or absent; (3) a graph site that current source contradicts is acted on; (4) a new parallel routing or eval surface exists instead of reuse of the existing one; (5) either file is red on the committed candidate. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read testing:runs rows for selective-assist.test.ts and selective-assist.integration.test.ts and capability:read packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/selective-assist.ts; cite the it() titles in markers (1)-(3) by name. GOVERNING DECISIONS: D-002 (installed GitNexus 1.6.9 stays the backend; no upgrade, no Codebase-Memory replacement). PASS when no marker holds.

criteria.title: Consumer evidence in existing BAR/rubric
criteria.model: Consumer evidence rides on the existing acceptance BAR/rubric, bound to its index and source revision with the unchecked set stated, and neither a graph invocation nor zero graph callers satisfies it.
criteria.driftMarkers: BROKEN if any ONE holds: (1) consumer-evidence.test.ts 'a graph INVOCATION with no consumers and no independent sweep is not evidence' or 'ZERO callers from the graph alone (graph-empty) is not evidence of absence' is red or absent; (2) consumer-evidence.integration.test.ts 'NEGATIVE: a stale index is bound to its OWN revision, so the mismatch is visible' or 'NEGATIVE: a backend that throws falls back, and unchecked behavior keeps the outcome nonpassing' is red or absent; (3) a consumer list is presented without its index revision and unchecked set; (4) a new rubric/BAR scorer exists parallel to the existing acceptance method; (5) a mandatory failure or unknown leaves a passing rating. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.

verification.method: Read testing:runs rows for both consumer-evidence tests at the committed candidate and cite the it() titles in markers (1)-(2) by name. RATING BASIS: healthy only when no marker holds on the committed candidate; any marker holding, or a required row unmeasured, is not healthy.
